description: This file defines the ScalarType enum, associated type mappings, and utility functions for scalar data types used in the PyTorch library. It includes macro-based listings of supported scalar types, complex types, quantized types, and float8 types, along with template specializations and conversion functions.

classes.name: dummy_uint1_7_t
classes.description: Dummy template struct for uint1 to uint7 types, to be implemented in Python with Tensor subclass.

classes.name: dummy_int1_7_t
classes.description: Dummy template struct for int1 to int7 types, to be implemented in Python with Tensor subclass.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts ScalarType enum to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads stream insertion operator for ScalarType.

methods.name: isQIntType
methods.description: Checks if a ScalarType is a quantized integer type.

methods.name: toUnderlying
methods.description: Returns the underlying ScalarType for quantized types.
